# Game board / season

 A Fallout 76 season usually lasts about 3 months. During this time, you can complete in-game challenges, receive tickets for them, and redeem rewards for these tickets. In this category we present rewards from the current or upcoming season in the articles. Even if there is information about the season or fundamental changes, you can read it here.
